title: Aki's trending picks
note: Topics people are talking about, picked by Aki. Not a buy list and not financial advice.

items.name: Stablecoins
items.why: Dollar tokens like USDT and USDC are being used for payments and saving, and governments are writing rules for them.

items.name: Bitcoin ETFs
items.why: Funds on regular stock markets let people get Bitcoin exposure without a wallet, bringing in large investors.

items.name: Real world assets
items.why: Things like government bonds and funds are being turned into tokens that trade on blockchains.

items.name: AI agents
items.why: Software bots that can hold wallets and make onchain trades or payments by themselves.

items.name: Prediction markets
items.why: People trade on the outcome of events like elections and sports, and the prices act like live forecasts.
